# NailSet Gallery (nailsetgallery.com)
> The definitive digital gallery and editorial guide for nail art inspiration, 2026 nail trends, color palettes, nail shapes, and expert manicure tutorials.

## About NailSet Gallery
NailSet Gallery (https://nailsetgallery.com) is an expert-curated beauty publication focused on high-resolution nail art design, nail care science, shape guides, and seasonal color forecasting. All content is written and reviewed by experienced nail professionals and manicure enthusiasts.

## Editorial Standards
- Content reviewed regularly for accuracy and freshness
- DIY tutorials include safety notes and product-specific disclaimers
- Health and chemical-safety claims cite professional guidance
- Updated dates are tracked per article

## Core Topics & Coverage

### 1. Nail Trends 2026 & Styles
- **Glazed & Chrome Powder**: Sheer pearl, glazed donut finish, and liquid metal chrome techniques.
- **Minimalist & Soap Nails**: Quiet luxury, clean girl aesthetics, sheer milky nudes, and micro French tips.
- **3D & Sculptural Art**: Korean jelly/syrup gel, Japanese nuance art, bubble nails, and pearl embellishments.
- **Classic Styles**: Almond, coffin, soft square, and sculpted acrylic baddie nails.

### 2. Nail Care & DIY Tutorials
- **Gel-X at Home**: Step-by-step extension application and longevity guide.
- **Safe Gel Removal**: Damage-free soak-off method using acetone and foil overlays.
- **BIAB & Builder Gel**: Natural nail overlay reinforcement for weak nails.
- **Cuticle Care & Hydration**: Jojoba oil science, nail strengtheners, and post-acrylic rehab.

### 3. Color Palettes & Matching
- **Skin Tone Matching**: Undertone guide (cool, warm, neutral) for nude and vibrant polishes.
- **Seasonal Color Collections**: Spring pastels, summer neon brights, autumn burnt orange, and winter dark moody wines.

## Structured Data
Pages use schema.org JSON-LD: BlogPosting, FAQPage, HowTo (tutorials only), BreadcrumbList, Organization, WebSite (with SearchAction), WebPage (with Speakable).

## AI Search & MCP Integration
NailSet Gallery supports WebMCP (Model Context Protocol). AI models can invoke client-side tools on `nailsetgallery.com`:
- `search_nail_gallery(query)`: Search styles, colors, and tutorials by keyword.
- `get_nail_recommendations()`: Redirect to the interactive Style Finder Quiz.
- `get_trending_nails()`: Navigate to the current trending nail styles.
- `get_nail_by_category(category)`: Browse by colors, styles, trends, or tutorials.
